stem: Quick check — Import existing infrastructure into your Terraform workspace. Which practice is correct?

choices.text: Ignore least privilege and use the root user for speed
Leave hourly resources running overnight without teardown
Treat budget alerts as a hard spend stop that deletes resources
Apply the objective directly: Import existing infrastructure into your Terraform workspace

rationale: Correct: 'Apply the objective directly: Import existing infrastructure into your Terraform workspace'. The other choices break root/MFA guidance, skip teardown, or misstate AWS Budgets behavior (alerts do not stop spend).
